TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_ZHANGEWEILAIBA.desc: Upon pickup, choose an [blue]X[/blue]-cost card from your character pool and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The effects of your cost [blue]X[/blue] cards are increased by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_ZHANGEWEILAIBA.even: Choose an [blue]X[/blue]-cost card from your character pool and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The effects of your cost [blue]X[/blue] cards are increased by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_ZHANGEWEILAIBA.flav: Who needs foresight? I want it now!
Upon pickup, add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Barricade+[/gold] cards [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold] that already shares a name with a card in it, [gold]enchant[/gold] that card with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].

Add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Barricade+[/gold] cards [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold] that already shares a name with a card in it, [gold]enchant[/gold] that card with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
Barricade is a great card. Pick some more!
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BAIBAIXIANGXIANGRUA: Upon pickup, remove [blue]4[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold], then copy all Defends in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [green]Upgrade[/green] them.
Remove [blue]4[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold], then copy all Defends in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [green]Upgrade[/green] them.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_GEISHEHUAXIAOJIE.de: At the start of each combat, ALL enemies lose [blue]{StrengthLose}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Whenever you play a card, ALL enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], up to [blue]{StrengthLose}[/blue] times per enemy.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_GEISHEHUAXIAOJIE.fl: Let's reduce Miss Snake Plant's Strength a bit, shall we?
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HUOYANTUXI.title: Purifying Flame
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HUOYANTUXI.descript: When attacked, deal [blue]{FlameBarrierPower}[/blue] damage to the attacker.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HUOYANTUXI.flavor: Guys, that Flame Barrier damage is insane!
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.de: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]SnakeBite[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and future cards with "Snake" in their name with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.ev: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]SnakeBite[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and future cards with "Snake" in their name with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.fl: SnakeBite — the greatest card in Sts2, no contest!
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIYANDINGZHEN.title: Snecko's True Gaze
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIYANDINGZHEN.descr: Start each combat [red]Confused[/red]. At the start of your turn, choose a card. It is free to play this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIYANDINGZHEN.flavo: One True Gaze confirms it: way too costly.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIYANDINGZHEN.selec: Choose a card to make it free this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YISHIXINGQILE.title: Impulse Purchase
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YISHIXINGQILE.descr: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. After spending at the Merchant, [blue]1~2[/blue] random items for sale have their price reduced to [blue]0[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YISHIXINGQILE.event: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. After spending at the Merchant, [blue]1~2[/blue] random items for sale have their price reduced to [blue]0[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YISHIXINGQILE.flavo: Spend money to make... more spending money!
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YONGHENGKAIJIAWANGC: At the start of each combat, gain {PlatingPower} [gold]Plating[/gold]. Whenever you gain [gold]Plating[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_ZHIHUIJIZHONGBING.d: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] additional [gold]Orb Slots[/gold]. When you end your turn without playing any cards, gain [blue]{FocusPower}[/blue] temporary [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn, then [gold]Channel[/gold] {IceOrbNum} [gold]Frost[/gold] Orbs.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MORIYA_GOHEI.title: Moriya Gohei
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MORIYA_GOHEI.descri: Upon pickup, choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MORIYA_GOHEI.eventD: Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MORIYA_GOHEI.flavor: You can't be bound by common sense.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DAY_KAKUSEI.title: Daytime Guest Stars
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DAY_KAKUSEI.descrip: At the start of each combat, gain a [gold]Power Potion[/gold]. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] any [gold]Power[/gold] cards you generate.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DAY_KAKUSEI.flavor: How about turning it into gamma rays?
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SNAKE_AMULET.title: Snake Amulet
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SNAKE_AMULET.descri: If you have [blue]1[/blue] or fewer cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SNAKE_AMULET.flavor: They say carrying this charm keeps you healthy and strong.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_FROG_AMULET.title: Frog Amulet
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_FROG_AMULET.descrip: After you deal damage with a card, deal [gold]{ExtraDamage:percentLess()}%[/gold] of that damage to ALL enemies at the end of your next turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_FROG_AMULET.flavor: They say carrying this charm ensures you return home safely.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SAILOR_SUIT.title: Sailor Suit
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SAILOR_SUIT.descrip: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. When you would gain [gold]Frail[/gold], [gold]Weak[/gold], or [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], instead become immune and apply the same amount to ALL enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SAILOR_SUIT.flavor: No one can resist the charm of a girl in a sailor suit!
Believe in the [aqua]Moriya Shrine[/aqua] and receive a newcomer gift pack. — Bunbunmaru
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MIRACLE_NOBLE.title: Miracle Covenant
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MIRACLE_NOBLE.descr: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Miracle of the Sea Opening[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MIRACLE_NOBLE.event: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Miracle of the Sea Opening[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MIRACLE_NOBLE.flavo: Want to know what's on the other side of the sea? Just go take a look.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_WIND_PRIESTESS_WINE: Minty and creamy. More like a dessert than a drink.
At the start of each combat, choose [blue]{SelectCount}[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] [gold]The Defect[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. They are free to play this combat.
A lone hero bearing everyone's expectations, standing alone against Gremlin Nob. When it swings its righteous iron fist, the Spire is bathed in the light of hope. Let us call out its name——"Defect"!
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DRACULA_LEGACY.desc: Upon pickup, gain [blue]6[/blue] random relics. For each relic not gained this way, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP (minimum [blue]1[/blue] HP).
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DRACULA_LEGACY.even: Gain [blue]6[/blue] random relics. For each relic not gained this way, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP (minimum [blue]1[/blue] HP).
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DRACULA_LEGACY.flav: Remilia Scarlet is not a descendant of Dracula. But some treasures were indeed gifted by that Count.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_NIGHT_SERVANT.title: Night Servant
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_NIGHT_SERVANT.descr: Your [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] additionally contain one of [gold]Time Minion[/gold], [gold]Magic Minion[/gold], or [gold]Qi Minion[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_NIGHT_SERVANT.flavo: A servant's dignity is part of [jitter]her master's dignity[/jitter]. —Remilia Scarlet
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CRIMSON_CHALICE.des: Upon pickup, double your Max HP. Add [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Decay[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CRIMSON_CHALICE.eve: Double your Max HP. Add [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Decay[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CRIMSON_CHALICE.fla: Mistress only drinks [red]Type B blood[/red]. —Sakuya Izayoi
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BLOOD_FANG.title: Blood Fang
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BLOOD_FANG.descript: Upon pickup, lose half of your Max HP. Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BLOOD_FANG.eventDes: Lose half of your Max HP. Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BLOOD_FANG.flavor: She always spills so much blood when she drinks, staining her dress a deep [red]crimson[/red].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CRIMSON_CRYSTAL.des: At the start of each turn, if your HP is at least [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CRIMSON_CRYSTAL.fla: One of Remilia's treasures, with a blood-red color more vivid than any ruby in the world — though no phantom thief has ever set their sights on it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SPEAR_GUNGNIR.title: Gungnir
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SPEAR_GUNGNIR.descr: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Gungnir's Spear[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_LORDS_SUNSCREEN_CRE: All [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] are replaced with [gold]Rare[/gold] cards, and you may [gold]Take All[/gold].
Only immature vampires use parasols. Mature vampires have their maids apply sunscreen first.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_PRESERVED_RED_FOG.d: Upon pickup, duplicate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_PRESERVED_RED_FOG.e: Duplicate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_PRESERVED_RED_FOG.f: To surpass the so-called 'First Devil's' masterpiece 'Preserved Living Mist,' Remilia had me make this overnight. —Patchouli Knowledge
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_PRESERVED_RED_FOG.s: Choose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards to [gold]Duplicate[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_NOBLE_BROOCH.title: Noble Brooch
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_NOBLE_BROOCH.descri: At the start of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, then you may [gold]Transform[/gold] those cards again.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_NOBLE_BROOCH.flavor: Accept or defy your fate? Make your choice.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_THE_THIRD_EYE.title: The Third Eye
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_THE_THIRD_EYE.descr: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Scry[/gold] [blue]5[/blue], and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Eye of Satori[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_THE_THIRD_EYE.flavo: Ordinary people can act freely only because they cannot read each other's hearts.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HELL_ORIN.title: Hell's Cat Cart
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HELL_ORIN.descripti: When an enemy dies, heal [blue]{HealAmount}[/blue] HP. Whenever an [gold]enemy dies[/gold] or you [gold]Shuffle[/gold], if the heal amount is greater than [blue]0[/blue], draw [blue]1[/blue] card and reduce this effect by [blue]2[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HELL_ORIN.flavor: A Gothic-clad black cat prowls the streets of Former Hell, ferrying the bodies and souls of the departed on their final journey.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HELL_OKUU.title: Hell's Crow Feathers
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HELL_OKUU.descripti: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  If you end your turn with [blue]0[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, add a [gold]Burn[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and gain [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HELL_OKUU.flavor: The empty-headed hell crow accepted the mountain's energy, her delusions swelling her ignorant ambitions before they could cool.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MIND_PROBE.title: Mind Probe
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MIND_PROBE.descript: After an enemy's attack is fully blocked by you, [gold]Stun[/gold] that enemy. Once per enemy per combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MEMORY_FLASK.title: Memory Flask
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MEMORY_FLASK.descri: Upon pickup, choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MEMORY_FLASK.eventD: Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.desc: Upon pickup, choose any number of cards from [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of your current character's cards. These cards will not appear in future [gold]Card Rewards or the Merchant[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.even: Choose any number of cards from [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of your current character's cards. These cards will not appear in future [gold]Card Rewards or the Merchant[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.flav: Does a soul trapped in a corner, unable to control its own body, feel lonely?
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.sele: Choose any number of cards to exclude from future [gold]Card Rewards and the Merchant[/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.forg: You have not forgotten any cards yet.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DUSTY_ROSE.title: Dusty Rose
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DUSTY_ROSE.descript: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Closed Eye[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DUSTY_ROSE.flavor: The door to her room in the Palace of the Earth Spirits is never closed, yet even as the roses wilt and dust gathers, her lively yet hazy figure never appears.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BITTER_COFFEE.title: Energizing Coffee
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BITTER_COFFEE.descr: The first time your {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} reaches [blue]0[/blue] each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_BITTER_COFFEE.flavo: Bitter work calls for something sweet — hence, coffee with sugar.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_OBLIVION_FRAGMENT.d: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [sine][blue]Neow's Starting Relics[/blue][/sine].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DETECTIVE_STORY.des: Attacks deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage to enemies not intending to Attack. At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] [blue]{RetainCard}[/blue] additional card for each enemy intending to Attack.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DETECTIVE_STORY.fla: "It is the brain, the little gray cells on which one must rely. One must seek the truth within——not without."——Hercule Poirot
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MINI_SHRINE.title: Mini Shrine
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MINI_SHRINE.descrip: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Tribute[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Your [gold]Gold[/gold] is automatically converted into [gold]Tribute[/gold] progress.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MINI_SHRINE.eventDe: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Tribute[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Your [gold]Gold[/gold] is automatically converted into [gold]Tribute[/gold] progress.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MINI_SHRINE.flavor: No one knows what deity is enshrined within.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DONATE_MONEY_BOX.de: When you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], gain [blue]{CardRewards}[/blue] [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] and {Gold}~{GoldMax} [gold]Gold[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DONATE_MONEY_BOX.fl: You can't hear any sound when you shake it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_CHARM.title: 博丽御札
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_CHARM.descr: 战斗开始时，选择一个选项进行[gold]祈愿[/gold]。
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SUBSPACE_HOLE.title: Subspace Hole
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SUBSPACE_HOLE.descr: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SEALING_NEEDLE.desc: Attacks deal [blue]additional[/blue] damage to [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies equal to their [gold]Weak[/gold] stacks, and apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to the target.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SEALING_NEEDLE.flav: It's said to also be good for promoting blood circulation.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIN_YANG_ORB.title: Yin-Yang Orb
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIN_YANG_ORB.descri: Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Strength[/gold]. Whenever you play an Attack, gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_YIN_YANG_ORB.flavor: Taiji gives birth to two opposites.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DUPLEX_BARRIER.desc: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] times. When you enter a combat by ignoring the path, enemies will have only [blue]1[/blue] HP.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_DUPLEX_BARRIER.flav: A mysterious power that can even flip space itself.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_AMULET.desc: When you take unblocked damage no higher than [blue]{Threshold}[/blue], reduce it to [blue]1[/blue] and decrease the threshold by [blue]1[/blue] for this combat, to a minimum of [blue]{MinThreshold}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_AMULET.flav: A large batch of talismans hand-drawn by Reimu, but completely unsold due to a lack of worshippers.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_GOHEI.title: Hakurei Gohei
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_GOHEI.descr: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dream Seal[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HAKUREI_GOHEI.flavo: A handy trick for exorcising youkai.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_MYSTIC_FORTUNE_PEAC: Whenever you play an Attack, a Skill, and a Power, remove all your negative effects and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
The peaches of heaven are absolutely delicious!
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CURSE_BREAKER_QI.de: Upon pickup, gain [blue]9[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red]. You may play [red]Curses[/red] that are normally unplayable. The first time you play a [red]Curse[/red] each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], {Energy:energyIcons()}, and draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CURSE_BREAKER_QI.ev: Gain [blue]9[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red]. You may play [red]Curses[/red] that are normally unplayable. The first time you play a [red]Curse[/red] each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], {Energy:energyIcons()}, and draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CURSE_BREAKER_QI.fl: A celestial's great fortune can suppress even the most vicious god of calamity's misfortune.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_FIRMAMENT_SASH.desc: Whenever you take unblocked damage not caused by yourself, reduce it by up to [blue]{Mitigation}[/blue] and record the amount reduced. At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to the recorded amount to yourself and reset it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_FIRMAMENT_SASH.flav: It's said to reflect different weather depending on her mood.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_SUPREME_HEAVEN_SEAL: Upon pickup, choose an [green]Upgraded[/green] Ancient card and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] no longer drop.
Choose an [green]Upgraded[/green] Ancient card and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] no longer drop.
Choose an [green]Upgraded[/green] Ancient card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HISOU_SWORD.title: Hisou Sword
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HISOU_SWORD.descrip: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]All Creation's Hisou[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HISOU_SWORD.flavor: A weapon capable of reading an opponent's temperament, one that only a celestial can fully master.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_KEYSTONE_FLOATING_C: Whenever you play a Skill, plant a [gold]Keystone[/gold]. Whenever you play an Attack, uproot the [gold]Keystone[/gold], dealing [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies and increasing the [gold]Keystone[/gold]'s damage by [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] this combat.
Used to suppress the Oo-Namazu that causes earthquakes... not that Preon has any of those.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HOLY_ARMOR.title: Heavenly Armor
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HOLY_ARMOR.descript: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  The first [gold]Block[/gold] gained from cards each turn is [purple]halved[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HOLY_ARMOR.flavor: Wearing it lets you enter a state of no thought, feeling no pain... or so they say.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CELESTIAL_INDIFFERE: At the end of your turn, [green]Upgrade[/green] any cards you obtained this turn and the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Heavenly indifference is the greatest fear of youkai.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_HEAVENLY_REVELATION: At the start of the [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, double all your [gold]positive powers[/gold].
Let the lowly mortals on earth taste the terrible food of heaven! Then they'll never envy the celestial life again! —Tenshi Hinanawi
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_COSMIC_DECREE.title: Heavenly Decree
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_COSMIC_DECREE.descr: Upon pickup, gain the relic: [gold]Divine Right[/gold]. See [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] cards from [gold]{Character}[/gold]. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_COSMIC_DECREE.event: Gain the relic: [gold]Divine Right[/gold]. See [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] cards from [gold]{Character}[/gold]. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_COSMIC_DECREE.flavo: Deigning to keep company with ordinary mortals is also a celestial's duty, after all.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_COSMIC_DECREE.selec: Select any number of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_LOSE_MONEY.title: Gold for Luck
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_LOSE_MONEY.descript: Whenever you play [blue]{CardsNeeded}[/blue] cards, spend [blue]{GoldCost}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_WHITE_RABBIT_AMULET: Upon pickup, remove all non-Eternal [red]Curses[/red] from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Prevent [red]Curses[/red] from being added to your [gold]Deck[/gold] afterwards.
Remove all non-Eternal [red]Curses[/red] from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Prevent [red]Curses[/red] from being added to your [gold]Deck[/gold] afterwards.
A common talisman for warding off evil spirits, made more valuable with a rabbit motif.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CARROT_NECKLACE.des: Upon pickup, remove up to [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The Merchant's card removal fee is doubled.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_RELIC_CARROT_NECKLACE.eve: Remove up to [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The Merchant's card removal fee is doubled.
